description_en: Retrieves an authorization code that contains user identity and permission information, which can be used to invoke cloud applications in integration scenarios
description_zh: 获取一个包含用户身份信息和权限信息的授权码，在集成场景中可使用该授权码唤起云应用
name: GetAuthCode

parameters.help_en: The external user ID. This ID is customized by the caller and must be unique within an Alibaba Cloud account. This parameter and ExternalUserId cannot be left empty at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 外部用户ID，该ID由调用方自定义，确保在一个阿里云账号下唯一即可。不能和`EndUserId`同时为空
parameters.name: external_user_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the Wuying convenience account. The username must be unique within an Alibaba Cloud account. This parameter and ExternalUserId cannot be left empty at the same time
parameters.help_zh: 无影便捷账号的用户名，在一个阿里云账号下唯一。不能和`ExternalUserId`同时为空
parameters.name: end_user_id

parameters.help_en:
The access policy that restricts the access permissions of the authorization code. If this parameter is left empty, no restrictions are applied.

Syntax:

```json
{
      "Version": "1",
      "Resource": {
            "Type": "<resource type>",
            "Id": "<resource ID>"
      }
}
```

Valid values for <resource type>:

AppInstanceGroup: app instance group. You can call the ListAppInstanceGroup operation to obtain the ID.
AppInstance: app instance. This is a dedicated field.
App: application. You can call the ListAppInstanceGroup operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh:
权限策略，限制授权码的访问权限，为空表示不限制。

语法：

```json
{
      "Version": "1",
      "Resource": {
            "Type": "<资源类型>",
            "Id": "<资源ID>"
      }
}
```

其中，<资源类型>的取值范围是：

AppInstanceGroup：交付组（ID可通过ListAppInstanceGroup接口获取）
AppInstance：应用实例（专用字段）
App：应用（ID可通过ListAppInstanceGroup接口获取）
parameters.name: policy

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to synchronously create an EndUserId based on ExternalUserId. This parameter takes effect only when EndUserId is left empty
parameters.help_zh: 根据`ExternalUserId`确认是否同步新建EndUserId。仅在`EndUserId`取值为空时生效
parameters.name: auto_create_user

parameters.help_en: The token type. Valid values: LoginToken (logon token) and StsToken (temporary identity credential)
parameters.help_zh: 令牌类型。取值：LoginToken（登录令牌）、StsToken（临时身份凭证）
parameters.name: token_type

parameters.help_en: The account type. Valid values: ad (enterprise AD account) and simple (convenience account)
parameters.help_zh: 账号类型。取值：ad（企业AD账号）、simple（便捷账号）
parameters.name: account_type

parameters.help_en: The Active Directory domain name. This parameter is required when the account type is ad
parameters.help_zh: ActiveDirectory域名，当账号类型为ad时需要填写
parameters.name: ad_domain

parameters.help_en: The password of the enterprise AD account
parameters.name: ad_password

AuthCode.description_en: The authorization code. The authorization code is valid for 3 minutes and can be used only once regardless of whether the verification succeeds or fails. If multiple authorization codes are generated for a user, only the last generated one is valid
AuthCode.description_zh: 授权码。该授权码有效期为3分钟，且无论校验成功或失败，只能被使用一次。当为一个用户生成多个授权码时，只有最后一次生成的有效

EndUserId.description_en: The username of the Wuying convenience account
EndUserId.description_zh: 无影便捷账号的用户名

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the authorization code. The time is displayed in UTC and follows the ISO 8601 standard
ExpireTime.description_zh: 授权码过期时间，采用ISO 8601标准的UTC时间
